# pai db

Look into the PAI database (read only)

```
pai db <command>
```

Look into the PAI database (read only).

```sh
pai db tables
pai db schema registry_projects
```

### pai db query

Run a SQL query

```
pai db query SQL [options]
```

Run a SQL query.

Run a SQL query against the selected database

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SQL` | yes | The SQL query, in quotes |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--db TARGET` | string | — | Database target: sqlite (default) or postgres |
| `--json` | flag | — | Output results as JSON array |

```sh
pai db query "SELECT count(*) FROM projects"
pai db query "SELECT slug FROM projects LIMIT 5" --json
```

See also: `pai db tables`

### pai db tables

List the tables

```
pai db tables [options]
```

List the tables.

List all tables in the selected database

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--db TARGET` | string | — | Database target: sqlite (default) or postgres |
| `--json` | flag | — | Output as JSON array |

```sh
pai db tables
pai db tables --json
```

See also: `pai db schema`, `pai db query`

### pai db schema

Show the columns of a table

```
pai db schema TABLE [options]
```

Show the columns of a table.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TABLE` | yes | Table name (see: pai db tables) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--db TARGET` | string | — | Database target: sqlite (default) or postgres |
| `--json` | flag | — | Output as JSON array |

```sh
pai db schema projects
pai db schema projects --json
```

See also: `pai db migrate-to-postgres`, `pai db tables`

### pai db migrate-to-postgres

One-time copy of the data from SQLite to PostgreSQL

```
pai db migrate-to-postgres [options]
```

One-time copy of the data from SQLite to PostgreSQL.

One-shot migration of kg_entities, registry tables, and memory/vault rows from SQLite to Postgres

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Preflight + counts only — no writes, no pg_dump |
| `--skip-dump` | flag | — | Skip the pg_dump rollback artefact (tests only) |
| `--allow-running` | flag | — | Skip the daemon-not-running refusal (tests only) |

```sh
pai db migrate-to-postgres --dry-run
pai db migrate-to-postgres --skip-dump
```

See also: `pai db schema`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai db query` | Run a SQL query |
| `pai db tables` | List the tables |
| `pai db schema` | Show the columns of a table |
| `pai db migrate-to-postgres` | One-time copy of the data from SQLite to PostgreSQL |
